Investigation.description: A falsifiable commission, not a prescribed investigation procedure.

available_work.description: Concrete discriminating work possible now, not merely a future disclosure. Do not prescribe agent count, filenames, passes or a mandatory reasoning order.
available_work.title: Available Work

decision_test.description: Explain how different findings could change or refute the assessment. Full is allowed to replace the question and discover additional unknowns.
decision_test.title: Decision Test

Investigation.title: Investigation

evidence_artifact_ids.description: FACT and MARKET_CONTEXT require at least one supplied Evidence ID. Use only the trusted host evidence_ids allowlist, not nested document IDs. Identify the underlying document/page in statement when citing an admitted bundle.
evidence_artifact_ids.title: Evidence Artifact Ids

statement.description: State the observation or reasoning and its source scope. FACT means a supplied source observation, not an inferred cause. Never relabel INFERENCE or ASSUMPTION as FACT to satisfy a route; a source citation does not turn inference into fact.
statement.title: Statement

counterevidence_review.description: State the actual counterevidence review scope, adverse information, strongest alternative explanation and unexamined areas. Having no established contrary FACT is permitted; not checked is not ruled out. Keep inference honestly labelled.
counterevidence_review.title: Counterevidence Review

explanation.description: Readable answer to what is worth attention and why: observation/why now, company economic connection and potential materiality, current evidence and existing-research relation when supplied. These are outcome responsibilities, not mandatory headings, reasoning order or a miniature Full Research report.
explanation.title: Explanation

route.description: STOP means no worthwhile further work within the declared scope. WAIT_FOR_TRIGGER requires a specific future wait_trigger. FULL_CANDIDATE requires investigation (question, why_material, available_work, decision_test) and at least one FACT or MARKET_CONTEXT claim with evidence_artifact_ids. Explain a real company connection and work possible now; unknowns alone are not a reason to escalate. Neither an established variant nor a contrary FACT is mandatory. Required-source or technical failure is a host execution gap, not a completed business WAIT or STOP.
route.title: QuickRoute
